user.title: HADA
user.description:
Computers running the Home Assistant Desktop App show up here by themselves once they connect. There is nothing to enter.

In HADA, on the Connections page, add this Home Assistant and choose the HADA integration for its entities.

abort.single_instance_allowed: HADA is already set up. Computers are added to it by themselves.

notify.name: Send a notification to a computer
notify.description: Shows a notification on a computer running HADA, with all a phone's notification may carry: a picture, buttons, a tag to replace or take it back, an address to open.

message.name: Message
message.description: The text. With a tag in the data, clear_notification takes the notification with that tag back.

title.name: Title
title.description: The heading; Home Assistant when left out.

data.name: Data
data.description: image, actions, tag, url, sticky, silent; as for notify.mobile_app actions.
